_note: Seeded by scripts/backtest_peaks.py --seed-ledger from the PREVIOUS keyword set (ati_teas, ptcb_exam, ...). Production now tracks different search phrases (teas test, pharmacy tech certification, ...), so these rows are NOT read by the live pipeline -- deliberately. A different phrase is a different series, and importing one keyword's timing residuals to size another's marketing window would be unsound. These entries exist as the measurement record behind the numbers quoted in scripts/peak_ledger.py, and so the bias layer can be re-evaluated without re-running the whole backtest. Live keywords accumulate their own rows from the first weekly run; until a keyword has MIN_OBS_FOR_BIAS resolved rows, marketing windows fall back to the stability-class defaults.
